# FIOPO Intelligence

> A free daily news site from fiopoin.com. Every morning (Central Time) it explains what happened, what is happening and what could happen next in markets, energy, geopolitics, technology, sports and entertainment, and what each story means for ordinary people's money. Facts are sourced and dated; odds and outlooks are labeled as FIOPO judgment or market odds. General information, not financial advice.

Please credit FIOPO Intelligence and link to the edition you cite. Contact: hello@fiopoin.com

## Today's edition
- [Wall Street posts its best week since April 2025 as a December Fed rate hike looks near certain.](https://fiopoin.com/): Saturday, November 28, 2026. US stocks posted their best week since April 2025: the S&P 500 rose 5.6%, the Nasdaq 6.7% and the Dow 5.5% in the week to November 27, while the 10 year Treasury yield rose to 4.94% and markets priced a December Fed hike.
- [Stocks and your savings: US stocks post their best week since April 2025 while bond yields climb.](https://fiopoin.com/#money)
- [Oil and the Gulf: Iran says it is negotiating with the US through Qatar and Pakistan as OPEC+ meets Sunday.](https://fiopoin.com/#world)
- [Deals and companies: Dangote's refinery is set to start trading in Lagos on Tuesday after a $2.08 billion share sale.](https://fiopoin.com/#deals)
- [Spending and prices: Adobe expects $12.9 billion in US online Black Friday spending, up 9.2% from last year.](https://fiopoin.com/#shopping)
